_comment: Tier-2 for febio::biphasic#6. <analysis>STATIC</analysis> in a biphasic deck gives 'tag "analysis" (line N) : invalid value: STATIC' — a clean parse error, not a silent fallback. The second half is executed rather than inferred: <analysis>1</analysis> is accepted, runs to normal termination, and its logged element sz;p match the TRANSIENT run bit for bit while differing from the STEADY-STATE run — so the raw ordinal really does select TRANSIENT here. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
